scenes.heading: What is Delta Lake?
scenes.subheading: Reliable tables on your data lake
scenes.narration: Delta Lake is an open storage format that adds reliability and transactions to data stored as files in your data lake.

scenes.heading: Core ideas
bullets: Parquet data plus a transaction log
scenes.narration: A Delta table is Parquet data files paired with an ordered transaction log that records every change. That log gives you ACID transactions, so concurrent reads and writes stay consistent. It also enables schema enforcement and time travel, letting you query earlier versions of the data.

scenes.heading: How a write works
scenes.narration: When you write, Delta creates new Parquet files rather than editing in place. It then appends an entry to the transaction log describing the change. Because that commit is atomic, readers only ever see a fully consistent version of the table.

scenes.heading: Creating a Delta table
scenes.narration: Declaring a table with USING DELTA tells Databricks to manage it as a Delta table with a transaction log. The insert that follows is wrapped in an ACID transaction. If it were to fail partway, the table would remain unchanged rather than left half-written.

scenes.text: Delta Lake turns a pile of files into a dependable table with transactions, versioning, and quality guarantees.
scenes.narration: In short, Delta Lake turns a loose pile of files into a dependable table with transactions, versioning, and quality guarantees.
